description:
The workspace's prepaid credit: balance, what a new paid run can use, each engine's check price and about how many checks that covers, auto-refill, and today's free allowances.

Billing: free — works at a zero balance.

When to call: before a large paid run (get_share_of_voice on many prompts, crawl_site on a big site; their dry_run: true gives the exact quote), or after out_of_credits. Paid results already carry balance_cents after their charge.

Returns { balance_cents, balance_usd, available_cents (less credit held by runs in flight), prices_cents_per_check, estimated_checks_left, auto_refill | null, spend_approved (true: the user approved agents spending this credit without asking per call; the balance is the limit), billing_url (null for an agent workspace: use create_top_up_link), free_today?: { technical_audit?: {used, of, then_cents} }, first_topup_match: { eligible, cents } | null (eligible: the first top-up is matched up to cents), suggested_next?, next_step? }. When the credit can't cover one citation check and auto-refill is off, suggested_next is create_top_up_link for $10: relay it once.
name: get_balance
title: Get the workspace's AuditAE credit balance
